text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus receives a commendation
from the
student council for identifying
the person who
made a mess of the
flowerbed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So, I hear you used cleat tracks to solve
the
flowerbed incident.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I didn't do it alone. The case would
still be a
mystery if not for Bamboo and
Helios's
cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, using the culpr—ah,
Bamboo's—footprints to
figure out what
happened is quite a feat.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
One might even say it was a stroke of
genius.
Surely your knowledge of cleats
is second to
none.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I simply have a great deal of
respect
for cleat-fitters and some
rudimentary knowledge
of their craft,
having studied it in my own time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Respect, you say? Indeed, the master
cleat-fitter
can discern a runner's growth
and bad habits from
their cleats alone.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes... That's exactly right. You seem
very
well-informed yourself.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Are you by any chance acquainted
with a
cleat-fitter?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A certain someone has taken good
care of
me for many years. I always get
them to make my
cleats.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I thought as much! In fact, I've thought
so for
some time!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Is that right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Your speed, your center of gravity, your
form...
They're all flawless in every
respect!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
But no ordinary cleats would be able to
endure
such exemplary running. You
would need cleats of
the same caliber!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's it! I knew you had custom
cleats!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: H-hey...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and Air Groove! Pardon my
impertinence, but
I wonder if you
wouldn't benefit from switching to

heavier cleats...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm positive it would improve your
performance
on corners!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And as for you hiding under the desk
there! Teio!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I think you could truly realize your
potential with
lighter cleats. It would
relieve some of the burden
on you while
you run!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I see... Wait, how did you know I
was here?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's certainly clear that you've got
a deep
passion for cleats. One might
even say too deep.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Essentially, I forgot myself for a moment
and
started rambling about cleats...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, it happens. Don't worry about it
too much.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
But I've always struggled with this.
Honestly, this
lack of self-control
worries me sometimes...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh boy, you're really beating yourself
up about
this, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice timing. Did you hear all that?
Can you
offer a few words of
encouragement?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice timing. Did you hear all that?
Can you
offer a few words of
encouragement?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am. If I wasn't confident, I
wouldn't
have said any of it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So, what's the trouble? You came out
with all that
'cause you want what's best
for the student
council, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
This'd be a whole nother story if the
student
council didn't want to hear it,
but did any of them
look like they
wanted you to pipe down?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Not particularly, but...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I... suppose. All right, I'll take your word
for it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Oh, in that case!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If it's not a bother, then I really ought to

recommend them all a cleat specialist I
know!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at what you've unleashed...
You sure
that was the best advice?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But humans don't wear cleats...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hm. Cleats for humans? Now that you
mention
it... I've never given it much
thought.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
With the differences in skeletal structure
and
muscle mass... No, it'd be better to
start by
considering the merits of fitting
a human with
cleats in the first place...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uhhh, Ikuno? I think maybe you've gone
and
slipped into cleat mode again.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, I need something to work
off of.
Trainer, would you mind running
for me? That'll
help us establish the best
approach!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hoo boy, I sure didn't see this coming...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Still, this is for Ikuno's benefit, so I'm gonna help out. You should too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, I don't think refusing is an
option.
And so, I find myself roped into
Ikuno Dictus's
human cleat research.
